title: HydraStore current architecture and workflows

annotation_legend.purpose: 中文注释用于说明模块职责、同步/异步边界、状态可见性和并发安全约束，不替代源码证据。
annotation_legend.solid_line: 同步主请求或当前步骤
annotation_legend.dashed_line: 异步触发、状态回写或兼容路径
annotation_legend.published: 只有 PUBLISHED/READY 状态对后续读取或搜索可见

diagrams.title: 总体架构与请求入口
annotations: 入口注释：浏览器只访问 Nginx，由 URL 决定进入 legacy、V2、静态资源或 FastDFS 直读。
一致性注释：MySQL 保存逻辑状态，FastDFS 保存物理 Blob，Redis 只承担协调/临时状态。
claims: Nginx terminates HTTPS and routes legacy APIs, V2 object APIs, static assets, and direct FastDFS URLs.
V2 object APIs are load-balanced across two Gateway services with sixteen workers per instance.
MySQL owns logical state; FastDFS owns physical blobs; Redis is coordination/cache state; AI workers are asynchronous.

evidence.why: Current Compose services, health dependencies, workers, network, and volumes.
Current routing, gateway upstream, FastDFS module, buffering, and timeouts.
Runtime process map for legacy CGI, Gateway-only, GC-only, and AI workers.
BlobStore Put/Get/Delete implementation over FastDFS.

diagrams.title: 小文件 legacy / 大文件 V2 上传
annotations: 分流注释：当前前端以 10 MiB 为阈值，小文件走 legacy，大文件走 V2 manifest + chunk_blob。
提交注释：物理分片完成校验后才 READY，commit 才把逻辑对象和引用一次性提交。
claims: The current uploadImage entry chooses legacy upload for files up to 10 MiB and V2 object upload above that threshold.
V2 computes a content MD5 and per-part SHA-256, then runs init, adaptive part upload/status polling, and commit.
Commit creates or reuses the manifest and relations in one MySQL transaction and enqueues source parsing.

evidence.why: Single-scan digest and per-part SHA-256 calculation.
Current V2 uploadObject workflow.
Current size-based legacy/V2 branch in uploadImage.
V2 init, part, status, and commit request handling.
Session resume, digest/size dedup, leases, and part declarations.
Fenced part publication and atomic commit.

diagrams.title: 下载、分享、删除与 GC 生命周期
annotations: 下载注释：按 manifest 顺序读取 READY 分片，再通过 BlobStore 流式返回。
删除注释：先删除用户关系；只有零引用、无活跃上传且 grace period 到期才允许物理回收。
claims: Manifest downloads read ordered READY chunks and stream each physical blob back through the Gateway.
Deleting one user reference preserves shared physical chunks; zero-reference chunks enter a grace-period GC flow.
GC checks for active uploads, claims DELETING, deletes FastDFS data, and retries with backoff on failure.

evidence.why: Private/share manifest lookup and ordered streaming download.
Manifest-backed ordered reconstruction and digest/size verification for worker reads.
Reference-aware object deletion and GC_PENDING transition.
Expired-upload reconciliation, GC claim, delete finalization, and retry.
Ten-second reconcile/physical-delete worker loop.

diagrams.title: AI 异步证据、Wiki 与索引
annotations: 异步注释：上传响应只入队，解析、embedding、Wiki 和 FAISS 由 worker 异步完成。
可见性注释：STAGING 不对搜索开放，只有 PUBLISHED generation 才能被读取。
claims: Upload commit and describe enqueue parse_source work; knowledge workers claim tasks with worker and lease fencing.
Evidence is built in a new generation and published atomically; failed staging does not replace the previous published generation.
Wiki revisions use citation validation and page-level base-revision CAS; the index worker builds immutable per-user snapshots.

evidence.why: Describe and rebuild become queued/dirty operations.
Object commit enqueues parse_source in its transaction.
Task claim, lease renewal, completion, retry, and enqueue semantics.
Source read, image/text processing, chunking, embedding, staging, and evidence publish.
Evidence generation, atomic publish, and fenced abort behavior.
Wiki patch validation boundary, revision CAS, citation insert, and publish transaction.
Dirty index claim, active vector load, immutable FAISS build, and fenced publish.

diagrams.title: AI 语义搜索
annotations: 只读注释：搜索不 rebuild、不 append，只消费已发布的 per-user FAISS snapshot。
补全注释：FAISS 返回稳定 ID 后，由 MySQL 做用户过滤、片段、Wiki claim 和 citation hydration。
claims: Search embeds the query, reads only the published per-user FAISS snapshot, filters by score, and hydrates results through MySQL.
Search returns file matches with chunk IDs/snippets and Wiki claims/citations without rebuilding or appending the index.

evidence.why: Query embedding, published generation lookup, FAISS search, score filtering, and SQL hydration.
Published index state and user-filtered active vector/hydration queries.
Per-user versioned knowledge_index_state schema.

diagrams.title: 关键状态与并发不变量
annotations: 状态注释：READY 表示物理 Blob 已校验并可被 manifest 引用。
回收注释：GC_PENDING 是延迟回收状态，DELETING 失败后可退回并重试。
claims: A chunk moves from MISSING/UPLOADING to READY only after physical Put and hash verification with matching owner and lease epoch.
Zero-reference cleanup requires a grace period and no active upload before DELETING.
Current and published AI generations are separated so readers never see incomplete staging data.

evidence.why: Part claim, lease epoch fencing, ready transition, and failure transition.
Recoverable backend ID, hash validation, cleanup, and fenced publication path.
V2 unique digest/size key, manifest relations, session, and part constraints.
AI current/published generation and stable vector/index state schema.

not_claimed: This bundle is a static source-grounded architecture snapshot, not proof of a fresh full-stack runtime run.
No new benchmark, DashScope smoke, long-running lease/GC test, or physical multi-storage failure result is inferred from these diagrams.
